title: OP AUTO FARM FAST OP TELEPORT SYSTEM Galaxy Hub
features:
Main Tab
- FoundOwnBase Paragraph (Your base: Base Number)
- Anti Sinking (Toggle)
- Upgrade Speed (1x)
- Upgrade Speed (5x)
- Upgrade Carry
- Rebirth
- Reset Data (Button with Confirmation Dialog)
- Spin Wheel
- Upgrade Base (Toggle)

Farm Tab
- Select Zone Dropdown (Entities Zones)
- Refresh Zones
- Collect Selected Zone (Once)
- Auto Collect Selected Zone (Toggle)

Teleport Tab
- Select Player Dropdown
- Refresh Players
- Teleport To Player

Player Tab
- Speed Modifier (Toggle and Adjustable Slider)
- Jump Modifier (Toggle and Adjustable Slider)
- Noclip (Toggle)
- Infinite Jump (Toggle)
- Zoom Unlocker (Toggle)

Visual Tab
- Player ESP (Multi-select Dropdown)
- Player ESP Text (Name and Distance)
- Refresh Players
- Clear Selected ESP
- Brainrot ESP Name Dropdown (Multi-select)
- Enable Brainrot ESP (Toggle)
- Brainrot ESP Text (Name and Distance)
- Refresh Brainrot List
- Clear Brainrot ESP

Settings Tab
- Config Manager (Name Input, Save, and Load Configuration)
- Auto Save Config (Toggle)
- Auto Load Config (Toggle)
